title: CSCI 531 — Introduction to Security Measurement
subject: Computer Vision
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core algorithmic foundations and modern methods used for security evaluation and tools design.
Explain how theoretical models and user practice intersect in computer security evaluation.
Apply a structured pipeline approach to analyze security measurement challenges and design robust evaluation tools.
